formats.psx-card-raw: A PlayStation memory card as one raw image of the card's 128 KiB (sixteen 8 KiB blocks of 128-byte frames), with no header before it.
formats.ps2-file-card: A PlayStation 2 memory card as one file: the card's pages of 512 data bytes each followed by their 16 bytes of ECC, the card's size read off the file's length.
formats.ps2-folder-card: PCSX2's folder memory card: a directory standing for one card, its saves kept as the files and folders the card's file system holds.
formats.saturn-backup-ram: The Saturn's internal backup RAM: the 32 KiB that sit on the odd bytes of its bus window, stored packed and raw.
formats.saturn-backup-cartridge-4mbit: A 4 Mbit Saturn backup cartridge: the 512 KiB on the odd bytes of its bus window, stored packed and raw.
formats.saturn-backup-cartridge-8mbit: An 8 Mbit Saturn backup cartridge as Kronos keeps it: 1 MiB on the odd bytes of its bus window, stored packed and raw.
formats.saturn-backup-cartridge-16mbit: A 16 Mbit Saturn backup cartridge as Kronos keeps it: 2 MiB on the odd bytes of its bus window, stored packed and raw.
formats.saturn-backup-cartridge-32mbit: A 32 Mbit Saturn backup cartridge as Kronos keeps it: 4 MiB on the odd bytes of its bus window, stored packed and raw.
formats.gb-cartridge-ram: A Game Boy cartridge's save memory as one raw image from its first address: the RAM banks in order, one byte per address (an MBC2 cartridge's 512 four-bit cells one to a byte), and an MBC7 EEPROM's 16-bit words high byte first. Each emulator sizes the image its own way, and RetroArch loads what fits, so two lengths of this layout hold the same data where the cartridge's memory fits both.
formats.gb-cartridge-ram-mbc2-packed: mGBA's MBC2 RAM: the 512 four-bit cells packed two to a byte, the even cell in the low nibble, 256 bytes.
formats.gb-cartridge-ram-mbc6-with-flash: mGBA's MBC6 save: the cartridge's RAM followed by its flash in one image.
formats.gb-cartridge-ram-mbc7-low-byte-first: SameBoy's MBC7 EEPROM: its 16-bit words low byte first.
formats.gb-cartridge-ram-first-four-banks: Gearboy's Pocket Camera RAM: only the first four 8 KiB banks of the camera's 128 KiB, the banks Gearboy's MBC3 rule keeps.
formats.gb-cartridge-ram-tama5-mgba: mGBA's TAMA5 memory: the mapper's 32 bytes, one byte per TAMA5 RAM address.
formats.gb-clock-gambatte: Gambatte's cartridge clock: the 64-bit base time its clock's counters are derived from, 8 bytes.
formats.gb-clock-sameboy: SameBoy's clock section: the real and the latched clock registers, the last second it counted and its cycle count, laid out as its save state's rtc section.
formats.gb-clock-tgbdual: TGB Dual's clock: one 32-bit time the core keeps for every game, 4 bytes.
formats.gb-clock-vba-mbc3: An MBC3 clock as VBA-M lays it out: ten 32-bit registers (seconds, minutes, hours, days and control, then the same five latched) and a 64-bit time, 48 bytes. Gearboy keeps the time as 32 bits followed by a word it sets to zero, the same bytes while the time fits in 32 bits.
formats.gb-clock-vbam-huc3: VBA-M's HuC3 clock: the time it last read the clock at, as one time_t.
formats.gb-clock-vbam-tama5: VBA-M's TAMA5 clock: fourteen 32-bit clock registers and a 64-bit time.
formats.nds-card-raw: A DS game card's save memory, such as its EEPROM, FRAM, flash or NAND, as one raw image from its first address, one byte per byte of the chip, as long as the emulator sizes the card's chip.
formats.nds-dsv: DeSmuME's .dsv: the card's save memory as one raw image from its first address, padded with 0xFF to the next size of DeSmuME's table at or above the highest address the game wrote, followed by a 122-byte footer: an 82-byte line of text, six little-endian 32-bit fields (the size written, the padded size, the save type, the address size, the memory size and the version, 0) and the 16-byte cookie |-DESMUME SAVE-|.
